entities.summary: Seyyed Alauddin Hossein, better known as Khalifeh Soltan, and also known as Soltan al-Ulama, was an Iranian statesman and cleric, who served as the grand vizier of the Safavid king (shah) Abbas I, the latter's grandson Safi, and Abbas II.
